sokuppādana: [ soka + uppādana ]  CL=9 causing the arising of sorrow and grief. Socayissatī (jā, 1. 174) ti sokuppādanena sukkhāpessati. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 397. Sokuppādaneneva sarīraṃ sosenti, kisaṃ karonti. Mūlaṭī, 2. 67.
sokuppādanarasa: [ sokuppādana + rasa]  CL=9 has function of arising of sorrow. sokuppādanaraso, byasanapaccupaṭṭhāno. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 101. Visuddhi, 2. 136.
sokābhibhava: [ soka + abhibhava ]  CL=10 oppressed by sorrow. Gharāvā-sādihetu sokābhibhavena cittassa saṃkiliṭṭhataṃ dasseti. Udāna, ṭṭha. 301. (-aṃ, ṭī, 3. 132).
sokābhibhūta: [ soka + abhibhūta]  CL=10 (one) that is oppressed by sorrow. Sabbakālaṃ sokābhibhū-tāya matānaṃ puttādīnaṃ ---- bhavitabbanti dasseti. Udāna, ṭṭha. 385. (-cariyā, ṭṭha. 122).
sokābhāva: [ soka + abhāva ]  CL=10 has no sorrow. Yañca pecca sokābhā-vassa kāraṇaṃ samparāyikaṃ. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 230. (-thera, ṭṭha, 2. 270).
sokābhāvahetu: [ sokābhāva + hetu ]  CL=10 the cause that is absence of sorrow. see Sokahetu.
sokābhāvakara: [ sokābhāva + kara + a ]  CL=10 making the absence of sorrow. Samparāyiko (suttani. 307) ti iminā “Yassete caturo dhammā”ti vuttaṃ pecca sokābhāvakaraṃ samparā-yikaṃ. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 230.
sokādhikakata: [ soka + adhika + kata ]  CL=10 see Sokādivuḍḍhi. Sokādivuddhiyā janitavisādānaṃ anutthunanadukkhaṃ upāyā-so. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 139. Visuddhi, 2. 137.
sokādhikata: [ soka + adhikata]  CL=10 See Sokādhikakata. Ñātibya-sanādinimittameva sokādhikatāya “Kahaṃ ekaputtaka, kahaṃ ekaputtakā”ti paridevavasena lapanaṃ paridevo. Ma, ṭī, 1. 332.
sokādhikatājanita:
[ sokā-adhikatā + janita ]  CL=9 Causes that lead to excessive sorrow/grief:
Ñātibyasanā-dinimittameva sokādhikatājanito “Kahaṃ ekaputtakā”tiādinā. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 450.
'Excessive sorrow caused by misfortunes such as loss of relatives, as in [the case of the mother crying] "Where is my only son?"'
sokādianatthapaṭibāhana: [ soka + ādi + anattha + paṭibāhana ]  CL=10 prevent the useless sorrow and so so on. Tato paraṃ sokādianatthapaṭibāha-natthaṃ ---- osānagāthamāha. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 188.
sokādianatthuppatti: [ sokādi-anattha + uppatti ]  CL=10 appearance of useless sorrow and so on. Sokādi-byasanappattīti sokādianatthuppatti. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 249.
sokādianekavihitabyasanāvaha: [ sokādi + aneka + vihita + byasana + āvaha ]  CL=10 carrying the destroyance of many sorrow and so on. . Sokādi-byasanappattīti sokādianatthuppatti. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 249.
sokādibyasanappatti: [ sokādi + byasana + patti ]  CL=9 reaching destroying due to sorrow and so on. see Sokādianatthuppatti.
sokādidhamma: [ sokādi + dhamma ]  CL=10 the dhamma that beginnning with sorrow.  Saṃsāradhamma-to hi sokādidhammato vā esa visuddhaṃ (visiṭṭhaṃ) nibbānaṃ nayati. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 104. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 127.
sokādidukkha: [ sokādi + dukkha ]  CL=10 suffering that has sorrow and so on. Svāhaṃ yamidaṃ snehanvayaṃ sokādidukkhaṃ pahoti. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 174. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 103.
sokādiggahaṇa: [ sokādi + gahaṇa]  CL=10 the word such as taking sorrow and so on. Sokādi-byasanappattīti sokādianatthuppatti. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 249.
sokādittaya: [ sokādi + taya ]  CL=10 a group of three- sorrow and so on. Sokādi-byasanappattīti sokādianatthuppatti. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 249.
sokādivatthubhūta: [ sokādi + vatthu + bhūta ]  CL=9 base/ground of sorrow and so on.  Tvaṃ pana sokā-divatthubhūtāya atthitāya tuṭṭho. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 35.
sokādivuddhi: [ sokādi + vuddhi ]  CL=10 see Sokādivuḍḍhi. Sokādivuddhiyā janitavisādānaṃ anutthunanadukkhaṃ upāyā-so. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 139. Visuddhi, 2. 137.
sokādivuḍḍhi: [ sokādi + vuḍḍhi ]  CL=9 increase of sorrow and so on. Sokā-divuḍḍhiyā janitavisādānaṃ anutthunanadukkhaṃ upāyāso. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 103.
sokānugata: [ soka + anugata]  CL=10 Follow to sorrow. see Sokappatta.
sokānuvattaka: [ soka + anuvatta + ka ]  CL=10 see Sokānugata. Sokābhibhūto sabbakiccāni pahāya sokānuvattakova ahosi. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 126.
sokāpahata: [ soka + upahata ]  CL=10 opressed by sorrow.  Sokāpahato (thera. 238) ti ---- sokena upahato mā bhava māhosīti attho. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 224.
sokāpanodana: [ soka + apano-dana]  CL=10 remove the sorrow. Ñātibhogādibyasana-patitesu sokāpanodano ullumpana-sabhāvāvaṭṭhito hutvā. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 303.
sokāra: [ so + kāra ]  CL=10 so word. recite "so".  so-saddā-akkharā. Kiṃ so (suttani. 326) ti ettha “So vuyhamāno”ti iminā ca sokārena tassa nagarassa niddiṭṭhattā nipātamatto sokāro. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 64.
sokātura: [ soka + ātura ]  CL=10 oppressed by sorrow. Tassa sokāturassa soka-vūpasamanatthaṃ ----. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 129. Sokaṭṭāyā (jā, 1. 393) ti sokāturāya. “Sokaṭṭhāyā”tipi pāṭho, soke ṭhitāyāti attho. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 95.
sokāvatiṇṇa: [ soka + ava + tiṇṇa=tara + ta. sokaṃ avataratīti sokāvatiṇṇā. pācita်, yo. 200 ]  CL=10 falling/entering into sorrow. Sokāvatiṇṇaṃ janatamapetaso-ko. Vi, 3. 6. Dī, 2. 33. Ma, 1. 225.

Sokāvāsā nāma paresaṃ dukkhaṃ uppādeti, sokaṃ āvisati. Vi, 2. 446. Sokāvāsanti saṅketaṃ katvā āgacchamānā purisānaṃ anto sokaṃ pavesetīti sokāvāsā, taṃ sokāvāsaṃ. sokī: [ soka + ī. thī-၌ sokinī. ေ$ာkinī-saṃ. ]  CL=10 due to sorrow. Socī ca paridevī cā (aṃ, 3. 117) ti sokī ca paridevī ca. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 241. Sokīnaṃ janānaṃ sokanudā bhavanti. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 518.

[ soma + ṇa ]  CL=7 One who reveres the Soma deva. Buddho assa devatā buddho, ---- yāmo, somo. Kaccaññaḥ. 191-nhā. Rū. 229, 405-nhā.
somadatta:
[ soma + datta. somadatta-saṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) A person named Somadatta. (2) Two young men named Somadatta. (3) A prince named Somadatta, the younger brother of Sutasoma. (4) A young elephant Somadatta. (5) somadattajātaka, Jātaka 211 (JA211), Jātaka 410 (JA410).
(1) Yāva devadattassa jarā, yo somadattassa jarā. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 219. Aññataro nesādabrahmaṇo somadattena nāma attano puttena saha taṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā. Cariyā, ṭṭha. 118. somadattajātaka: [ somadatta + jātaka ]  CL=7 Jātaka 211 (JA211), Jātaka 410 (JA410). Somadatta-jātakaṃ paṭhamaṃ. Jā, 1. 56-7, 168.
somadattajātakavaṇṇanā:
[ somadatta-jātaka + vaṇṇanā ]  CL=7 The commentary on the Somadattajātaka.
Somadattajātakavaṇṇanā paṭhamā. Jā, ṭṭha, 2. 152. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 369.
somadeva:
[ soma + deva. somadeva-saṃ. lanata်sāး. vīlyaṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) Somadeva, the lay disciple of Lord Buddha Koṇāgamana.(2) A universal monarch named Somadeva.
(1) Uggo ca somadevo ca, ahesuṃ aggupaṭṭhākā. Buddhavaṃ. 375. (2)Ito ca navame kappe, somadevasanāmakā. Apa, 1. 190.
somadevasanāmaka: [ somadeva + samāna + nāma + ka ]  CL=7 One who has the same name as Somadeva. See - somadeva.
somakāraka: [ soma + kara + ṇvu ]  CL=7 Somakāraka, who holds the wrong view of the pāsaṇḍa. Somakārakamugabbatacara-bāka, ---- pāsaṇḍā. Ma, ṭī, 2. 12.
somamitta:

somamittatthera:
[ somamitta + thera ]  CL=7 A thera named Somamitta.

somamittattheragāthā:
[ somamittatthera + gāthā ]  CL=7 The verse recited by the venerable Somamitta.
Khuddakanikāya, theragāthā pāḷi, 2-nipāta, 2-vagga, 4-gāthā. Thera. 250.
somamittattheragāthāvaṇṇanā:
[ soma-mittattheragāthā + vaṇṇanā ]  CL=7 The commentary on the verse of the venerable Somamitta.
Somamittatthera-gāthāvaṇṇanā niṭṭhitā. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 339.
somanassa:

somanassabhāvappatti:

somanassabāhullappatti:
[ somanassa + bāhulla + patti ]  CL=7 Reaching or achieving a state of rejoicing or happiness.

somanassadhammūpasauhita:

somanassadhātu:

somanassanekkhammassita:
[ somanassa + nekkhamma + sita ]  CL=7 Dependent on renunciation and associated with the sensation of happiness.
chattiṃsesu paṭhamapadesu cha somanassanekkhammassitā. Peṭako. 278.
somanassanāmalābha:
[ somanassa + nāma + lābha ]  CL=7 The acquisition of the name of the sensation of happiness.
Somanassa-nāmalābho iminā ārammaṇasaṅke-tenāti tadatthaṃ vivaranto ----. Netti, ṭī. 51.
somanassapaccaya:
[ somanassa + paccaya]  CL=7 A cause or support for rejoicing or happiness.
Ayaṃ pana somanassapaccayattā vitti-sarikkhatāya vitti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 187. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 116. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 18.
somanassapariggahita:
[ somanassa + pariggahita ]  CL=7 Grasped or taken up through the sensation of joy or happiness.
Imāsaṃ kamma-phalasaddhānugatānaṃ somanassapariggahi-tānaṃ tissannaṃ cetanānaṃ pāripūri. Peta, ṭṭha. 124. (-aṃ, ṭī, 3. 108).
somanassapariyosāna:
[ somanassa + pariyosāna ]  CL=7 Having the conclusion of joy or happiness or having the end that is happiness.
Dasannaṃ dukānaṃ samathādīnaṃ somanassapariyosānāni paṭhamāni dasa padāni paṭhamā disā. Netti, ṭṭha. 216.
somanassapatta:
[ somanassa1 + patta]  CL=7 Attained the rejoicing or happiness.
Sanniṭṭhānaṃ katvā somanassapatto sakalanagaraṃ alaṅkārāpetvā. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 235.
somanassapavedana:
[ somanassa + pavedana ]  CL=7 The sensation of rejoicing or happiness that is experienced or the known sensation of joy or happiness.
Tatrāti tasmiṃ somanassa-pavedane. Dī, ṭī, 3. 52.
somanassapaṭilābha:
[ somanassa + paṭilābha ]  CL=7 The attainment of rejoicing or happiness.
Uḷāraṃ so labhati devo somanassapaṭilābhaṃ. Dī, 2. 170. (-227).
somanassapaṭilābhakathā:
[ somanassapaṭilābha + kathā ]  CL=7 The speech related to rejoicing or happiness.
Dīghanikāya, mahāvaggapāḷi, 8-suta. Dī, 2. 227.
somanassapaṭisandhi:
[ somanassa + paṭisandhi ]  CL=7 Connection to the next existence is associated with happiness, or the link to the next existence is related to the sensation of joy.
Gabbhaseyyakasattānaṃ somanassapaṭisandhi natthi. Mūlaṭī, 3. 132. Anuṭī, 3. 183.
somanassapaṭisandhika:
[ somanassapaṭi-sandhi + ka ]  CL=7 Having the rebirth connection associated with happiness.
Kusalakiriyāya ānisaṃsadassā-vitā somanassapaṭisandhikatā. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 116.
somanassapaṭisandhisamāna:
[ somanassa-paṭisandhi + samāna ]  CL=7 Resembling the connection associated with happiness or similar to the happiness-associated connection.
Tattha kāmāvacaresu somanassapaṭisandhisamānatāya ----. Mūlaṭī, 3. 158.
somanassapaṭisaṃyuttagāthā:
[ soma-nassa + paṭisaṃyutta + gāthā ]  CL=7 The verse associated with happiness or rejoicing.
ṭhito samāno imā somanassapaṭi-saṃyuttagāthā abhāsatha kathesīti sambandho. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 344.
somanassarahita:
[ somanassa + rahita ]  CL=7 Free from the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Catūsupi vikappesu somanassarahitā honti. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 83. Somanassa-rahitāya pītiyā abhāvato. Dī, ṭī, 1. 61. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 228.
somanassarahitaaññāṇupekkhā:
[somanassarahita+ aññāṇa + upekkhā]  CL=7 Equanimity associated with knowledge that is free from the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Upekkhāti somanassarahita-aññāṇupekkhā. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 362.
somanassasahagata:
[ somanassa + sahagata ]  CL=7 Arising together with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassasahagata (abhi, dha. 17) nti sātamadhuravedayitasaṅkhātena somanassena saha ekuppādādibhāvaṃ gataṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 111. (-aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 252).
somanassasahagatamagga:
[ somanassa-sahagata + magga ]  CL=7 The lokuttarā path (lokuttarā magga) arises together with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Vuṭṭhi-tassa aṭṭhaṅgiko somanassasahagata-maggo hoti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 274.
somanassasahagatapaṭisandhi:
[ soma-nassasahagata + paṭisandhi ]  CL=7 The connection or link that arises together with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Upekkhāsahagatacutiyā somanassasahagatapaṭisandhi. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 154.
somanassasahagatapaṭisandhika:
[ soma-nassasahagatapaṭisandhi + ka ]  CL=7 One who has a connection or link associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Atha yadā somanassasahagatapaṭisandhikassa pavatte jhānaṃ nibbattetvā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 317. (abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 338).
somanassasahitañāṇasamuṭṭhāna:
[ somanassa+ sahita + ñāṇa + samuṭṭhāna ]  CL=7 See - somanassa sampayuttañāṇa samuṭṭhāna.
 “Aho sukhaṃ aho sukha”nti somanassasahitañāṇa-samuṭṭhānaṃ pītisamuggāraṃ samuggirati. Sārattha, 3. 411.
somanassasampayutta: [ somanassa + sampayutta ]  CL=7 Associated or linked with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness. Somanassūpavicārā (dī, 3. 202) ti somanassasampayuttā vicārā. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 217. (-aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 330. Visuddhi, 2. 85).
somanassasampayuttalobhasahagatacitta:
[ somanassasampayutta + lobha + sahagata + citta ]  CL=7 The mind accompanied by greed that is associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassasampayuttalobhasahagatacittena gāmanigamaviluppanaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ. Mūlaṭī, 3. 240.
somanassasampayuttamana:
[ somanassa-sampayutta + mana ]  CL=7 The mind associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
ete hi uppādapaccayaṭṭhena somanassasampayuttamano pubbaṅgamo etesanti manopubbaṅgamā nāma. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 24.
somanassasampayuttañāṇa:
[ soma-nassasampayutta + ñāṇa ]  CL=7 Wisdom associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Idha pana somanassañca somanassasampayutta-ñāṇañca adhippetaṃ. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 178.
somanassasampayuttañāṇasamuṭṭhāna:
[ somanassasampayuttañāṇa + samuṭṭhāna]  CL=7 A cause that is the wisdom associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
somanassasampa-yuttañāṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ udānaṃ udānesi. Udāna, ṭṭha. 40.
somanassasamuṭṭhāna:
[ somanassa + samuṭṭhāna ]  CL=7 A cause of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassasaṃvega (ma, ṭṭha, 2. 202) nti somanassasamuṭṭhānaṃ saṃvegaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 2. 221.
somanassasamuṭṭhānagāthā:
[ soma-nassasamuṭṭhāna + gāthā ]  CL=7 The verse concerning the origin or cause of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassa samuṭṭhānagāthāhi paṭimaṇḍitaṃ. Udāna, ṭṭha. 1.
somanassasaṃsaṭṭha:
[somanassa + saṃsaṭṭha ]  CL=7 Combined with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness by the power of ekuppāda and others.
Somanassasaṃsaṭṭhauhi idha somanassa-sahagatanti vuttaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 112.
somanassasaṃvega: [ somanassa + saṃvega ]  CL=7 The sense of urgency associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness. See - somanassa samuṭṭhāna.
somanassassādanākāra:
[ somanassa1 + assādana + ākāra ]  CL=7 The manner or quality of delight in the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassuppattiyaṃ yo purimavedanāya assādetabbākāro soma-nassassādanākāro. Dī, ṭī, 1. 151.
somanassasīsa:
[ somanassa + sīsa]  CL=7 The leading aspect of rejoicing or happiness.
Pahāso hi idha somanassa-sīsena vutto. Visuddhi, ṭī, 1. 381.
somanassauppādana:
[ somanassa + uppādana ]  CL=7 That which brings or causes happiness or joy.
Dhammaṃ suṇantānaṃ dhammadesanena cittassa anekavidhena somanassauppā-danañca. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 4.
somanassavacana:
[ somanassa + vacana ]  CL=7 (1) The term "somanassa". (2) The statement of the term "somanassa."
(1) anantaraṃ somanassa-vacanena sukhassa vuttattā sukhaṃ siddhaṃ. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 211. (2) sukhaṃ somanassanti ettha cetasikasukhabhāvadassanatthaṃ soma-nassavacanaṃ. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 135.
somanassavatī:
[ somanassa + vantu + ī. pu, na-၌ somanassavantu. ]  CL=7 A woman who is happy or rejoicing.
“Soma-nassā”tipi pāṭho, somanassavatī hutvāti attho. Jā, ṭṭha, 3. 486.
somanassavedaniya:
[ somanassa-vedanā + iya ]  CL=7 That which is a cause of the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Tasseva soma-nassavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā. Saṃ, 3. 187-8.
somanassavedanā:
[ somanassa + vedanā ]  CL=7 The sensation of happiness or rejoicing.
Soma-nassavedanāyetaṃ nāmaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 160. (-305. Mūlaṭī, 1. 86).
somanassavedanānurūpa:
[ somanassa-vedanā + anurūpa ]  CL=7 Conforming to or suitable for the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Tasseva soma-nassavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā. Saṃ, 3. 187-8.
somanassavega:
[ somanassa + vega ]  CL=7 The force or impulse of rejoicing or happiness.
Pītivegena patito somanassavegena ca sumano hutvā. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 1. 310. (-jā, ṭṭha, 5. 435).
somanassavicāra:
[ somanassa1 + vicāra ]  CL=7 The reflection arises with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
manovicāresu somanassavicāro chattiṃsesu paṭhamapa-desu cha somanassanekkhammassitā. Peṭako. 278.
somanassavidhura:
[ somanassa1 + vidhura ]  CL=7 The opposition of the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassavidhurattā domanassaṃ viyāti domanassanti vuttaṃ. Ma, ṭī, 3. 237.
somanassavippayogāsambhava:
[ somanassa + vippayoga + asambhava ]  CL=7 Not arising (or not possible) when free from the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Pītiyā somanassavippayogāsambhavatoti adhippāyo. Mūlaṭī, 1. 70.
somanassavippayuttacitta:
[ somanassa1 + vippayutta + citta ]  CL=7 The mind not associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
somanassavippa-yuttacittassa uppādakkhaṇe. Yamaka, 3. 119.
somanassavirahitasacakkhukapaṭisandhi:
[ somanassa + virahita + sacakkhuka + paṭisandhi ]  CL=7 That which arises due to the wisdom associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
somanassayuttañāṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ udānaṃ udānesi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 236.
somanassavirahitasacakkhukapaṭisandhinid:
[ somanassavirahitasacakkhuka-paṭisandhi + nidassana ]  CL=7 Indicating the connection or link (paṭisandhi) that possesses the faculty of sight and is free from the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassavirahitasacakkhuka-paṭisandhinidassanavasenā (mūlaṭī, 3. 158) ti somanassavirahitasacakkhukapaṭi-sandhiyeva nidassananti yojetabbaṃ. Anuṭī, 3. 215.
somanassayutta:
[ somanassa + yutta]  CL=7 See - somanassasampayutta.
Dviṭṭhānā manoviññāṇadhātu somanassayuttā. Visuddhi, 2. 85.
somanassayuttacitta:
[ somanassayutta + citta ]  CL=7 The mind associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Ahaṃ santuṭṭho somanassayutta-cittena saṅghassa lasuṇaṃ adāsiṃ. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 62.
somanassayuttakusalākusala:
[ soma-nassayutta + kusala + akusala ]  CL=7 Wholesome and unwholesome deeds associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Manā-paggahaṇena somanassayuttakusalā-kusalānaṃ ---- saṅgahitattā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 441.
somanassayuttañāṇasamuṭṭhāna:
[ soma-nassayutta + ñāṇa + samuṭṭhāna ]  CL=7 That which arises due to the wisdom associated with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
somanassayuttañāṇasamuṭṭhānaṃ udānaṃ udānesi. Vi, ṭṭha, 3. 236.
somanassañāṇamayika:
[ somanassa + ñāṇa + mayika ]  CL=7 Accomplished by the wisdom associated with the Somanassa.
Udāna (paṭisaṃ. 332) nti somanassañāṇamayikaṃ udāhāraṃ. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 219.
somanassaṭṭhāna:
[ somanassa + ṭhāna ]  CL=7 The condition of the sensation of rejoicing or happiness (somanassa vedanā).
Somanassaṭṭhāne panettha upekkhā-vedanā hoti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 298.
somanassaṭṭhāniya:
[ somanassa + ṭhā + anīya. nī-၌ i-rassa raṃkhāpru. ]  CL=7 A cause of the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassaṭṭhāniya (dī, 3. 203) nti somanassakāraṇabhūtaṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 217. (-aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 161).
somanassika:
[ somanassa + ika ]  CL=7 That which pertains to joy or mental happiness.
[Hasantopi hi somanassiko ullapati bhāyantopi majjhattopīti. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 92. (-vi, ṭṭha, 4. 225).]
somanassikacitta:
[ somanassika + citta]  CL=7 The mind associated with happiness.
Yasassa pabbajjāya soka-sallasamappitattā dānañca somanassika-cittena na dadeyyaṃ. Vajira. 410.
somanassikakāla:
[ somanassika + kāla ]  CL=7 A time or period of rejoicing or happiness.
Puthujjanassa kāma-guṇe paribhuñjitvā somanassika-kālo. Jā, ṭṭha, 5. 272.
somanassindriya:
[ somanassa + indriya]  CL=7 The mental faculty of rejoicing or happiness.
Sukhindriyaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ domanassindriyaṃ upekkhindriyaṃ. Saṃ, 3. 183. (-abhi, dha. 17. Abhi, ka. 12, 188).
somanassindriyapahāna:
[ somanassindriya + pahāna ]  CL=7 Abandoning the mental faculty of rejoicing or rejecting the mental faculty of happiness.
Cittabhāvanāya somanassindriyapahānaṃ paṭijānāti. Peṭako. 295.
somanassindriyapaṭipakkha:
[ soma-nassindriya + paṭipakkha ]  CL=7 The opposition of the mental faculty of rejoicing or happiness.
So sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya somanassindriya-paṭipakkhena. Peṭako. 264.
somanassindriyasamuṭṭhita:
[ soma-nassindriya + samuṭṭhita ]  CL=7 Arisen from the mental faculty of rejoicing or originated from the mental faculty of happiness.
Idaṃ rūpaṃ somanassindriyasamuṭṭhitaṃ. Paṭisaṃ. 109. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 315.
somanassindriyasamuṭṭhāna:
[ soma-nassindriya + samuṭṭhāna ]  CL=7 That which arises by the mental faculty of rejoicing or happiness.
Idaṃ rūpaṃ somanassindri-yasamuṭṭhānaṃ. Visuddhi, 2. 39.
somanassita:
[ somanassa + ita. moga်, 4. 45. so်manasyita-saṃ. so-maṇasiya-prā. ]  CL=7 Being happy or having attained happiness.
Evaṃ tava mano somanassito vā doma-nassito vā kāmavitakkādisampayutto vā. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 322. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 152.
somanassitakāla:
[ somanassita + kāla ]  CL=7 See - somanassikakāla.
Somanassitakāle uppannaṃ hi rūpaṃ siniddhaṃ mudu pīṇitaṃ phassavantaṃ hoti. Visuddhi, 2. 259.
somanassitādipaṭipakkha:
[ soma-nassita + ādi + paṭipakkha ]  CL=7 That which opposes aspects such as happiness, and so on.
Iṭṭhādīsu chasu ārammaṇesu somanassitādipaṭipakkhā chaḷaṅgupekkhā vuttā. Vimati, 2. 99.
somanassupavicāra:
[ somanassa1 + upavicāra ]  CL=7 The thought or contemplation arises with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Somanassūpavicārā (dī, 3. 203) ti somanassasampayuttā vicārā. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 217. Somanassupavicārādīsu somanassena saddhiṃ upavicarantīti somanassupavicārā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 489. (-mūlaṭī, 2. 226).
somanassupavicāradāna:
[ somanassupa-vicāra + dāna ]  CL=7 Merits arise together with the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Chaṭṭhaṃ somanassupa-vicāradānaṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 169. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 175.
somanassuppatti:
[ somanassa1 + uppatti]  CL=7 The arising of the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Purimuppannaṃ (purimamuppannaṃ) vedanaṃ ārabbha soma-nassuppattiyaṃ ----. Dī, ṭī, 1. 151. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 409.
somanassuppādanattha:
[ somanassa + uppādana + attha ]  CL=7 The purpose of bringing about rejoicing or happiness or the benefit of bringing about happiness.
Bhagavā tassa somanassuppādanatthaṃ passantasseva paribhuñjitvā. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 142. “Idāni arahattappatto”ti somanassuppādanatthaṃ “Appamatto hotī”ti. Sārattha, 1. 59.
somanassādevippamukha:
[ somanassā-devī + pamukha ]  CL=7 Led by a queen Somanassā.
Somanassādevippamukhāni aṭṭhacattālīsa itthisahassāni paccupaṭṭhi-tāni ahesuṃ. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 263.
somanassādevī:
[ somanassā + devī]  CL=7 A queen named Somanassā.
Somanassā-deviyā putte anupamakumāre uppanne ----. Buddhavaṃ, ṭṭha. 263.
somanassādibheda:
[ somanassādi + bheda ]  CL=7 The variety of rejoicing or happiness, and so on.
Taṃ kāmāvacarakusalaṃ viya somanassādi-bhedato aṭṭhavidhaṃ. Visuddhi, 2. 85-7. (visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 126).
somanassādiānisaṃsa:
[ somanassa1 + ādi + ānisaṃsa ]  CL=7 The benefits associated with rejoicing or happiness, and others.
Somanassādiānisaṃsaṃ dassento yathodhi kho panassātiādimāha. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 177. Somanassādiānisaṃsaṃ dassetvā. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 178.
somanassādiānisaṃsadassana:
[ soma-nassādiānisaṃsa + dassana ]  CL=7 Demonstrating the benefits associated with rejoicing or happiness, and others.
Cattāropi pana vārā paccavekkhaṇākārappakāsanavasena ceva somanassādiānisaṃsadassanavasena ca vuttā. Ma, ṭī, 1. 277.
somanassākāra:
[ somanassa1 + ākāra ]  CL=7 The manner or aspect of rejoicing or happiness.
Piyaṃ somanassākāraṃ dassanaṃ yassa so piyadassī. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 156. (-ma, ṭī, 2. 68).
somanassānantaraṃ:
[ somanassa + anantaraṃ ]  CL=7 The immediate following of happiness or the sensation of joy that follows immediately.
Somanassānantarauhi domanassaṃ ---- paṭṭhāne paṭisiddhaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 318.
somanassānupatita:
[ somanassa + anupatita ]  CL=7 Following the sensation of rejoicing or happiness.
Dukkhānupatitaṃ somanassānupati-taṃ domanassānupatitaṃ. Abhi, ka. 303.
somanassānuyoga:
[ somanassa1 + anuyoga ]  CL=7 Happily making an effort or happily striving.
Ye kāmapaṭisandhisukhino somanassānuyogaṃ anuyuttā ----. Ma, 3. 274-5. Ma, ṭī, 3. 391.
somanassāvippayoga:
[ somanassa + avippayoga ]  CL=7 Always associated with the sensation of happiness.
Kasmā Somanassāvippayogato. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 241. Visuddhi, 1. 315.
somanassūpacāra:
[ somanassa + upacāra]  CL=7 See - somanassūpavicāra.
somanassabāhullappattiyā somanassūpacāraṃ nāma hoti. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 175.
somarukkha:
[ soma + rukkha. somavaÂkaË-saṃ. ]  CL=7 The Indian labumum tree (Cassia fistula).
Somarukkhā (jā, 2. 340) ti pītapupphavaṇṇā rājarukkhā. Jā, ṭṭha, 7. 305.
somavakkala:
[ soma + vakkala ]  CL=7 The bark of the tree called Soma or the bark of the soma tree.
Somavakkalādīsu yaṃ labhati, tena rajjitabbaṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 195. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 280. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 112.
somavaṃsa:
[ soma + vaṃsa. somavaṃ$-saṃ. ]  CL=7 The moon lineage.
Somavakkalādīsu yaṃ labhati, tena rajjitabbaṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 195. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 280. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 112.
somayāga:
[ soma + yāga= yaja + ṇa. somayañña, somayāga-saṃ. ]  CL=7 (1) Celebrating the soma offering to deities by drinking the beverage. (2) A hermit named somayāga.
(1) somayāge
(jā, 1. 234) ti navacande uṭṭhite somayāgaṃ nāma yakkhabaliṃ kariṃsu. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 119. (2) sattisayo yāmahanu, somayāgo manojavo. Jā, 2. 185. Jā, ṭṭha, 6. 124. (sī, syā, i-mū).
sombhā:
[ sumbha + ṇa + ā. nīti, dhātu. 125. $ုmbhā-saṃ. suṃbhā-prā. ]  CL=7 A doll, mannequin, or puppet.

Sotabbasāraṃ savanānuttariyaṃ catusaccaṃ pakāsento ----. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 17.
sotabbavatthudassana:
[ sotabba + vatthu + dassana ]  CL=7 The act of showing or presenting the object (or subject) that is worthy of being listened to.
Gāthāti sotabbavatthudassanaṃ. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 5.
sotabbayutta:
[ sotabba + yutta ]  CL=7 Suitable for being listened to or appropriate for listening to the teaching.
Sussūsā (thera. 250) ti sotabbayuttassa sabbasutassa sotumicchā. Thera, ṭṭha, 1. 333.
sotabbayuttaka:
[ sotabbayutta + ka ]  CL=7 See - sotabbayutta.
Savanīyo (dī, 2. 171) ti sotabbayuttako kaṇṇasukho. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 233.
sotabhūta:
[ sota + bhūta ]  CL=7 That which exists as a result of being a stream or that which arises due to the nature of the stream or hearing.
Taṃ kaṇhassa sota-bhūtaṃ dīgharattānusayitaṃ ----. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 83. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 537.
sotabila:
[ sota + bila ]  CL=7 The hole of the ear.
Viravaṃ nāma visesato sotabilaṃ. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 180.
sotadasaka:
[ sota + dasa + ka ]  CL=7 A collection of ten forms of sound recognized by ear sensitivity.
Sotadasakakalāpa. Cakkhudasakaṃ sotadasakaṃ ----. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 353. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 172.
sotadasakābhāva:
[ sotadasaka + abhāva ]  CL=7 Absence of a collection of ten forms of sound recognized by ear sensitivity.
Badhirassa sotadasakābhāvato. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 309.
sotadesa:
[ sota + desa ]  CL=7 The place of the faculty of hearing.
Sotapadesassāti sotadesassa, sotadese ṭhitassāti attho. Anuṭī, 1. 162.
sotadhātu:
[ sota + dhātu ]  CL=7 (1) The faculty of hearing, Sotapasāda. (2) Dibbasotābhiññāṇa, the divine ear, which is similar to the faculty of hearing.
(1) Dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti. Paṭṭhāna, 1. 135. (-abhi, ka. 50). (2) Dibbāya sotadhātuyāti ettha ---- dibbapasāda-sotadhātu hoti. Ayañcāpi imassa bhikkhuno vīriyabhāvanābala-nibbattā ñāṇasotadhātu tādisā-yevāti dibbasadisattā dibbā ----. Savanaṭṭhena nijjīvaṭṭhena ca sotadhātu. Sotadhātukiccakaraṇena ca sota-dhātu viyātipi sotadhātu, tāya dibbāya sotadhātuyā. Visuddhi, 2. 37. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 83.
sotadhātukiccakaraṇa: [ sotadhātu + kicca + karaṇa ]  CL=7 Performing the function of the faculty of hearing. See - sotadhātu (2).
sotadhātuvisuddhi:
[ sotadhātu + visuddhi ]  CL=7 Purified faculty of hearing (sotadhātuvisuddhi), which leads to supernatural hearing (Dibbasotābhiññāṇa).
Sotadhātuvisuddhiyā ñāṇa (abhi, vi. 347) nti dūrasantikādibhedasaddā-rammaṇāya dibbasotadhātuyā ñāṇaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 403. (-abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 443).
sotadhātuvisuddhiñāṇa:
[ sota-dhātuvisuddhi + ñāṇa ]  CL=7 The purified knowledge of hearing, which is the divine ear (dibbasotaabhiññā).
Sotadhātuvisuddhiñāṇa (paṭisaṃ. 3) nti ---- sotadhātu eva visuddhi sota-dhātuvisuddhi, sotadhātuvisuddhi eva ñāṇaṃ sotadhātuvisuddhiñāṇaṃ. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 48.
sotadvāra:
[ sota + dvāra ]  CL=7 (1) The door through which ear-consciousness arises. The ear sensitivity, functions like a door. (2) A cause of ear-consciousness is the ear-door.
(1) ---- dhammakathā vā sarabhaññaṃ vā sotadvāre āpātha-māgataṃ viya hoti. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 115. (2) Sotadvāre cittaṃ. Mahāni. 101.
sotadvāranissita:
[ sotadvāra + nissita ]  CL=7 Dependent on the ear door.
Sota-viññeyya (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 29) nti sota-dvāranissitena viññāṇena viññātabbaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 149.
sotadvāranissitaviññāṇa:
[ sota-dvāranissita + viññāṇa ]  CL=7 Ear consciousness is dependent on the ear door.
Na hi sotadvāranissitaviññāṇamattena dhammo viññāyati. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 149.
sotadvārapaṭibaddha:
[ sotadvāra + paṭibaddha]  CL=7 Connected to the ear door.
Aṭṭhakathā-vasena atthassa sotadvārapaṭibaddhatā-karaṇaṃ savanaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 244.
sotadvārappavattaviññāṇasantāna:
[ sotadvāra + pavatta + viññāṇa + santāna ]  CL=7 The continuum of ear consciousness that arises at the ear door.
Yā vacīghosārammaṇassa sotadvārappavattaviññāṇasantānassa anantaraṃ ----. Vajira. 198.
sotadvārasampattavacananigghosānusāra:
[ sotadvāra + sampatta + vacana + nigghosa + anusāra ]  CL=7 Recollecting the sound of the speech that arrives at the ear door.
Sotadvārasampattavacananigghosā-nusārena aññāsi. Vi, ṭṭha, 1. 83.
sotadvāravedanā:
[ sotadvāra + vedanā ]  CL=7 The sensation that arises through the ear door.
Sotadvāravedanādīsupi esevanayo. Sārattha, 3. 210.
sotadvāraviññāṇasantāna:
[ sota-dvāraviññāṇa + santāna ]  CL=7 The continuity of consciousness that is known or arises through the ear door.
Yā ca sota-dvāraviññāṇasantānānantaramuppannena ----. Anuṭī, 1. 191.
sotadvāraviññāṇattha:
[ sotadvāra + viññāṇa + attha ]  CL=7 The meaning is known through ear-consciousness.
Sotadvāra-viññāṇattho sutasaddo. Suttani, ṭṭha. 1. 122.
sotadvāravīthi:
[ sotadvāra + vīthi ]  CL=7 The continuity of consciousness arises through the ear door.
Cha vīthiyo pana cakkhudvāravīthi sotadvāravīthi ----. Saṅgaha. 56. Na pana sotadvāravīthivasena sutamattaṃ tena tadatthassa anadhiga-tattā. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 214.
sotadvārikajavanaviññāṇa:
[ sota-dvārika + javana + viññāṇa ]  CL=7 The impulsive consciousness that arises at the ear door.
Sota-dvāravasenā (kaṅkhā. 99) ti sota-dvārikajavanaviññāṇavasena. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 159.
sotadvārikaviññāṇa:
[ sotadvārika + pavatta + viññāṇa. alaya်puda်kye. ]  CL=7 The consciousness arises at the ear door.
Sotadvāriviññāṇānaṃ, tadabhinipātānañca manodvārikaviññāṇānaṃ gahaṇaṃ veditabbaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 150.
sotadvārikaviññāṇavīthi:
[ sota-dvārikaviññāṇa + vīthi ]  CL=7 The continuity of consciousness that arises at the ear door.
Na sotadvārika-viññāṇavīthi ekārammaṇeyeva pavattana-to. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 151.
sotadvārānusāra:
[ sotadvāra + anusāra ]  CL=7 Recollecting the sequence of sounds heard through the ear door.
Tassā sotadvārānusārena pavattāya viññāṇavīthiyā ----. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 6. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 5. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 5.
sotadvārānusāraviññātadhara:
[ sotadvārānusāraviññāta + dhara + a ]  CL=7 One who remembers the sequence of consciousness that follows the sound heard through the ear door.
“Sutadharo sutasannicayo”tiādīsu sota-dvārānusāraviññātadharoti attho. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 6. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 5.
sotadvārānusāraviññātattha:
[ sotadvā-rānusāra + viññāta + attha ]  CL=7 The meaning known by recollecting the sequence of consciousness that follows the sounds heard through the ear door.
Yato sotadvārānusāra-viññātatthe idha sutasaddoti vutto. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 150.
sotadvārānusāraviññāṇavīthi:
[ sotadvārānusāra + viññāṇa + vīthi ]  CL=7 The sequence of consciousness that follows the sounds heard through the ear door.
So atthato sotadvārā-nusāraviññāṇavīthiyā nānappakārena ----. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 151. (-sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 214).
sotadvārānusārañāta:
[ sota-dvārānusāra + ñāta ]  CL=7 Something is known by or by following the sequence of sounds that come through the ear door.
Sadde ca sotadvārānusārañāte ca dissati. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 13.
sotamanohara:
[ sota + mana + hara a ]  CL=7 That which attracts the mind and ear.
Taṃ sutvā vanasamiddhaṃ, mama sota-manoharaṃ. Apa, 2. 225.
sotanirujjhana:
[ sota + nirujjhana ]  CL=7 The cessation of the faculty of hearing.
Yāya paññāya anusayappahānena sota-nirujjhanaṃ vuttaṃ. Netti, vi. 97.
sotanissaya:
[ sota + nissaya ]  CL=7 Dependent on the faculty of hearing.
Nissayavasena sotanissaye allīyitvā. Mūlaṭī, 1. 148.
sotanissita:
[ sota + nissita ]  CL=7 Dependent on the faculty of hearing.
Na ca me sotanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissati. Ma, 3. 303.
sotaodahana:
[ sota + odahana ]  CL=7 Listening to the teachings.
Ā-tāvadhānūpanisūpapanne (suttani. 326) ti sotaodahanena ca maggaphalānaṃ ----. Suttani, ṭṭha, 2. 64.
sotapada:
[ sota + pada ]  CL=7 The word - sota.
Idha cakkhupadassa ṭhāne sotapadāni ----. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 348.
sotapadesa:
[ sota + padesa]  CL=7 Established in the place of the hearing faculty.
Sotapa(ppa)desassā (mūlaṭī, 1. 149) ti sotadesassa, sota-dese ṭhitassāti attho. Anuṭī, 1. 162. (-visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 369).
sotapasāda:
[ sota + pasāda ]  CL=7 The faculty of hearing.
Sota-pasādo sotadhātu. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 121.
sotapasādavatthuka:
[ sotapasāda + vatthu + ka ]  CL=7 Dependent on the faculty of hearing.
Sotapasādavatthukaṃ cittaṃ sota-viññāṇadhātu. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 121. Cakkhupasādavatthuṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ katvā pavattaṃ cakkhupasādavatthukaṃ. Sesapadesupi esevanayo. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 129.
sotapatha:
[ sota + patha ]  CL=7 (1) The path or way of the ear door. (2) The ear door as a cause or condition for hearing. (3) The path of the ear, far from hearing. (4) The arising of the faculty of hearing.
(1) (2) Sotapathamāgacchantaṃ tassa bhagavato vacanaṃ sabbappakārena ko samattho viññātuṃ. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 28. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 124. Sotameva sotapatho, savanaṃ vā sotaṃ. Tassa patho tathā, sotadvāranti attho. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 146. (3) Sace sotapathe āpāthamāgacchati ----. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 93. Tasmiṃ khaṇe pāpapuri-so thokaṃ paṭikkamitvā sotapatheva aṭṭhāsi. Jā, ṭṭha, 4. 259. (4) Sabbasattānaṃ sakasakabhāsānurūpato sota-pathamāgacchantaṃ tassa bhagavato ----. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 5. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 4. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 4. Taṃ taṃ upādāya vattabbatoti sota-pathamāgate dhamme upādāya tesaṃ ----. Ma, ṭī, 1. 30. Saṃ, ṭī, 1. 277. Aṃ, ṭī, 1. 29.
sotapathagamana:
[ sotapatha + gamu + yu ]  CL=7 Reaching the path of the ear door.
---- attano kāyajīvitanirapekkho paresaṃ sota-pathagamanamattenapi ----. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 117.
sotapathāgamana:
[ sotapatha + ā + gamu + yu ]  CL=7 See - sotapathagamana.
Māgadhabhāsāya hi tantiṃ āruḷhassa buddhavacanassa paṭisambhidāppattānaṃ sota-pathāgamanameva papañco. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 372. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 5. Aṃ, ṭī, 2. 349.
sotapatita:
[ sota + patita ]  CL=7 (1) Falling into the stream of teachings. (2) Falling into the stream.
(1) Taṃ imasmiṃ pañcaviññāṇasote patitattā sotapatitameva hutvā gataṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 343. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 201. (2) Te hi sotavasena vattamānā soto viya sotapatite satte apāya-samuddaṃ pāpenti. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 497.
sotapatitatta:
[ sotapatita + tta]  CL=7 A state of entering into the stream of teachings.
So-tapatitattā pana evaṃ tanti gatāti veditabbā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 210. (-mūlaṭī, 1. 144).
sotapavatta:
[ sota + pavatta ]  CL=7 Arising the hearing faculty.
Idaṃ ceva sotapavattaṃ. Paṭisaṃ. 97, 366.
sotapaṭighātasadda:
[ sota + paṭighāta + sadda ]  CL=7 The sound produced by the impact of the stream of water.
Na tassa sota-paṭighātasaddaṃ suṇāti. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 174.
sotapaṭihananalakkhaṇa:
[ sota + paṭihanana + lakkhaṇa ]  CL=7 The characteristic of contact with the faculty of hearing.
Sabbopi hesa sotapaṭihananalakkhaṇo saddo. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 356. Visuddhi, 2. 77.
sotapaṭipanna:
[ sota + paṭipanna ]  CL=7 One who has entered the stream.
Idaṃ pana aṭṭha dosavimuttattā sotapaṭipannassa dārukkhandhassa ----. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 74-5.
sotaroga:
[ sota + roga ]  CL=7 The disease related to the ear.
Cakkhurogo sotarogo ghānaro-go ----. Aṃ, 3. 343. Mahāni. 10. Cūḷani. 28.
sotasadda:
[ sota + sadda ]  CL=7 (1) The sound related to the ear. (Na) (2) Field of the eye (cakkhāyatana) and field of sounds (saddāyatana).
 (1) Sotasaddo anekatthappabhedo. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 12. (-aṃ, ṭī, 1. 39). (na) (2) See - sotasaddavajja.
sotasaddavajja:
[ sotasadda + vajja ]  CL=7 To be avoided or restrained concerning the sounds of the ear and the field of the eye (cakkhāyatana).
Puna dasannanti sotasaddavajjānaṃ andhavasena, badhiravasena cetaṃ dvayaṃ vuttaṃ. Anuṭī, 2. 70.
sotasadisa:
[ sota + sadisa ]  CL=7 Resembling the water stream.
Catūhi ākā-rehi taṇhāya sotasadisatā veditabbā. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 327. (-dī, ṭī, 3. 70).
sotasambandha:
[ sota + sambandha ]  CL=7 Associated with the word - sota.
Tañca viññāṇaṃ sotasambandhena sotaviññā-ṇanti viññāyati. Mūlaṭī, 3. 73.
sotasampadā:
[ sota + sampadā ]  CL=7 The completeness or achievement of the ear.
Cha bhavasātāti- cakkhusampadā sotasampadā. Mahāni. 23. (-61, 336. Cūḷani. 205). Sota-sampadādīsupi esevanayo. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 90.
sotasamphassa:
[ sota + samphassa ]  CL=7 Sotasamphassa (contact with the ear) - (A) The contact that arises together with ear-consciousness or hearing. (B) The arising contact is dependent on the faculty of hearing. (C) The contact arose due to the faculty of hearing. (D) The contact is the fruit or result of the faculty of hearing.
Cakkhusamphasso sotasamphasso ghānasamphasso. Dī, 2. 52. Ma, 1. 64. (A) Sotaghānajivhāpasādakāya-dvāresupi esevanayo. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 139. (B) Cakkhusamphasso (ma, 1. 64. Ma, 3. 259) ti cakkhumhi samphasso. Esanayo sabbattha. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 226. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 185. Sotasamphassādīsupi esevanayo. Dī, ṭṭha, 3. 216. (C) Sotato pavatto samphasso sotasamphasso. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 143. (B, C, D) sotasamphassotiādīsu cakkhusotādayopi ---- cakkhussa vā phalabhūto samphasso cakkhusamphasso. Abhi, ṭṭha. 3. 26.
sotasamphassaja:
[ sotasamphassa + jana + kvi ]  CL=7 That which arises from contact with the ear.
Sotasamphassajā vedanā. Dī, 2. 50. Ma, 1. 64. Saṃ, 1. 245. Sotasamphassajā (ma, 1. 243) ti upanissayavasena sotasamphassato jātā sotadvārajavanavedanā. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 129.
sotasamphassapaccaya:
[ sotasamphassa + paccaya ]  CL=7 A cause of contact with the ear.
Yamidaṃ sotasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā ----. Vi, 3. 44. Sota-samphassapaccayā vedanakkhandho atthi. Abhi, vi. 25.
sotasamphassāyatana:
[ sotasamphassa + āyatana ]  CL=7 (1) The field of contact with the ear. (2) The field of contact associated with the faculty of hearing.
(1) (2) cakkhusamphassāyatanaṃ sotasamphassā-yatanaṃ ghānasamphassāyatanaṃ. Ma, 3. 282.
sotasamāpanna:
[ sota + samāpanna]  CL=7 One who attained stream entry.
Sabbe sotasamāpannā, atiracchānagāmino. Saṃ, 1. 156. Sotasamāpannāti maggasotaṃ samāpannā. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 203.
sotasandanī:
[ sota + sandanī ]  CL=7 The body is dripping from the nine openings or holes.
Dhiratthu pūraṃ navahi sotasandani (thera. 360) nti nānappakārassa asucino pūraṃ navahi sotehi vaṇamukhehi asucisandaniṃ savati. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 476.
sotasukha:
[ sota + sukha ]  CL=7 Pleasure of hearing.
Savanī-yo (ma, 2. 340) ti sotasukho. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 270.
sotasukhassara:
[ sotasukha + sara]  CL=7 The sound that is pleasurable to hear.
Madhurassaro (dī, 2. 17) ti sotasukhassaro. Dī, ṭī, 2. 42.
sotatta:
[ su + tapa + ta. nīti, dhātu. 253. dhātvattha. 156. su + ava + tapa + ta. su-sadde u-kārassa o-kāraṃ katvā. suṭṭhu “avatattoti”ti vā sotatto. ma, ṭī, 2. 36. sidi + ta. nīti, dhātu. 91. ]  CL=7 Scorched or burnt.
Sotatto (ma, 1. 113) ti divā ātapena rattiṃ vanausmāya sutatto. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 353. Sotattho (jā, 1. 22) ti sūriyasantāpe suṭṭhu tatto. Jā, ṭṭha, 1. 414.
sotavantu:
[ sota + vantu. ေ္ra$ာtravata်-saṃ. ]  CL=7 One who possesses the wise ear.
Ye sotavanto pamuñcantu saddhaṃ. Vi, 3. 10. Dī, 2. 34.
sotavekalla:
[ sota + vekalla ]  CL=7 Deficient in the faculty of hearing.
Sotavekallatā natthi. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 72. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 55.
sotavicchedana:
[ sota + vicchedana ]  CL=7 Cutting off the stream of sound.
---- indriya-saṃvarūpanissayāya paṭisaṅkhānapaññāya chinditvā sotavicchedanavasena āva-raṇaṃ katvā. Thera, ṭṭha, 2. 478.
sotavikala:
[ sota + vikala ]  CL=7 One who is deficient in the faculty of hearing.
Cakkhuvikalasotavikalā viya cakkhusotavikalopi labbhati. Anuṭī, 3.
sotaviññeyya:
[ sota + viññeyya]  CL=7 (1) Heard by ear consciousness at the ear door. (2) Ability to hear through ear consciousness. (3) That which is heard through consciousness arising at the ear door. (4) Known by following to the ear door.
(1) Sotaviññeyya (dī, ṭṭha, 1. 29) nti sotadvāranissitena viññāṇena viññātabbaṃ, sasambhārakathā vā esā, sotadvārena viññātabbanti attho. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 149. (2) Sotaviññeyyā saddā. Vi, 3. 271. Dī, 1. 231. Ma, 1. 119. Ma, 2. 60, 117. Ye vā pana te dhammā sotaviññeyyā. Abhi, dha. 220. Etenupāyena sota-viññeyyādīsupi attho veditabbo. Dī, ṭṭha, 1. 335. Ma, ṭṭha, 1. 361. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 12. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 120. Sotaviññāṇena vā vijānitabbā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 400. Sota-viññāṇena jānituṃ sakkāti sota-viññeyyaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 374. (3) Sota-viññeyyātiādīsupi esevanayo. Ma, ṭī, 1. 41. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 139. (4) Vācasiko samācāro sotaviññeyyo dhammo nāma. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 279. Sotaviññeyyo-ti etthāpi esevanayo. Ma, ṭī, 2. 299.
sotaviññāṇa: [ sota + viññāṇa ]  CL=7 Ear consciousness (sotaviññāṇa) that depends on the faculty of hearing. (A) The consciousness (viññāṇa) of the faculty of hearing. (B) The consciousness arises due to the faculty of hearing.
sotaviññāṇadhātu:
[ sotaviññāṇa + dhātu ]  CL=7 The nature of the consciousness is fundamentally linked to the faculty of hearing.

Eko pana sotuṃ sakkoti. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 107. Sotunti aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetassa samannāharitvā sotumpi. Ma, ṭī, 3. 321.
sotāgata:
[ sota + āgata ]  CL=7 Arrived at the faculty of hearing.
Aya-massa sotāgatatāya sota-sadisatā. Dī, ṭī, 3. 7.
sotānugata:
[ sota + anugata ]  CL=7 That which is accompanied by or follows the faculty of hearing.
Sotānugatānaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ vacasā paricitānaṃ ----. Aṃ, 1. 504-5. Sotānugatānanti pasādasotaṃ oda-hitvā ñāṇasotena vavatthapitānaṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 364. Sotānugatā hontīti sotaṃ anupattā anupaviṭṭhā honti. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 364. Sotā-nugatānanti pasādasotaṃ anugantvā gatānaṃ. Aṃ, ṭī, 2. 361.
sotānuggahakara:
[ sota + anuggaha + kara + a ]  CL=7 One who offers support or assistance to the faculty of hearing.
Tassa sotānuggaha-karo gandhabbapuriso viya imissāpi ----. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 226.
sotānuggatadhamma:
[ sotānuggata + dhamma]  CL=7 The dhamma that is associated with the faculty of hearing.
Sotānugatadhammesu, imā tesaṃ uddānagāthā. Peṭako. 196. (-324).
sotānusāra:
[ sota + anusāra ]  CL=7 Following after the water stream.
---- gaṅgāto heṭṭhā sotānusārena ahaṃ vajāmi. Apa, ṭṭha, 2. 106.
sotāpanna:
[ sota + āpanna. ေ္ra$ာtāpanna-sakkatapiṭaka. ]  CL=7 (1) A person who has attained the fruit of stream-entry. (2) A person who is on the path of stream-entry. (3) Sotāpannasutta, Saṃyutta Nikāya 22.109 (SN22.109), 23.7 (SN23.7), 48.26 (SN48.26), 48.32 (SN48.32).
(1) Sotāpannassā (paṭisaṃ. 374) ti sotāpattiphalaṭṭhassa. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 252. (-mahāni, ṭṭha. 86. Netti, vi. 173). (2) Anāgāmīnaṃ visuṃ vakkhamānattā āha sotāpannasakadāgāmīnanti, etena sekkhabhāvasāmaññena maggaṭṭhāpi vuttāti veditabbā. Maṇimañjū, 1. 506. (3) Sotāpanno arahā ca. Saṃ, 2. 132.
sotāpannabhāvalakkhaṇa:
[ sotāpanna-bhāva + lakkhaṇa ]  CL=7 The sign or characteristic of a sotāpanna person.
Na sotāpannabhāvalakkhaṇanti dasseti. Netti, ṭī. 132.
sotāpannabhāvaparidīpana:
[ sotāpanna + bhāva + paridīpana ]  CL=7 Showing the characteristics of a person who has entered into the path of stream-entry.
Tathāpi sotāpanna-bhāvaparidīpanatthaṃ pasādadassanatthañca vācaṃ bhindati. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 212.
sotāpannabhāvāpagama:
[ sotāpanna-bhāva + apagama ]  CL=7 Free from the state of a sotāpanna person.
Na cettha sakadāgāmi-bhāvāpattiyā sotāpannabhāvāpagamo parihāni hoti visesādhigamabhāva-to. Anuṭī, 3. 84.
sotāpannabhāvāpatti:
[ sotāpanna-bhāva + āpatti ]  CL=7 Reaching the state of a sotāpanna person.
Sotaṃ vā ariyamaggaṃ ādito panno adhigato-ti sotāpannoti vuccamāne dutiya-maggaṭṭhādīnaṃ nattheva sotāpannabhāvāpatti. Anuṭī, 3. 49.
sotāpannabhāvāvijahana:
[ sotāpanna-bhāva + avijahana ]  CL=7 Not giving up the state of a sotāpanna person.
Puna sotāpannassa sotāpannabhāvāvijahanato dutiya-paṭiññāpi tasseva. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 128.
sotāpannabhūmi:
[ sotāpanna + bhūmi]  CL=7 The realm or state associated with a sotāpanna.
sotā-pannabhūmiyaṃ bhabbuppattiko ca hotīti vuttaṃ “Niyatagatiko”ti. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 385.
sotāpannaggahaṇa:
[sotāpanna + gahaṇa]  CL=7 The word - sotāpanna.
Sotā-pannaggahaṇeneva cettha sakadāgāmīpi gahito hoti. Udāna, ṭṭha. 63.
sotāpannakusala: [ sotāpanna + kusala ]  CL=7 Wholesome qualities of a person who has entered into the stream. Ayaṃ hettha attho- khīṇāsavampi so-tāpannakusalaṃ paññapeti sekkhabhūmiyaṃ ṭhitattā. Ma, ṭī, 3. 129.
sotāpannakāla:
[ sotāpanna + kāla ]  CL=7 A moment of entering into the stream.
Vessavaṇassa sotāpannakālato pubbe nayanāvudhena ---- deviddhi veditabbā. Vi, ṭṭha, 2. 40.
sotāpannalakkhaṇa: [ sotāpanna + lakkhaṇa ]  CL=7 The characteristics of a sotāpanna. Tena sotāpannalakkhaṇamete dhammā. Netti, ṭī. 132.
sotāpannasadisa: [sotāpanna + sadisa ]  CL=7 That which is similar to a sotāpanna. Sotāpannasadisāneva tāni kulāni. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 265.
sotāpannasamaṇa:
[sotāpanna + samaṇa]  CL=7 A sotāpanna bhikkhu or a bhikkhu who has entered the path of stream-entry.
Samaṇopi tattha na upalabbhatīti paṭhamo sotā-pannasamaṇopi tattha natthi. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 181. Dī, ṭī, 2. 183.
sotāpannasata:
[ sotāpanna + sata]  CL=7 One hundred sotāpanna persons.
Evaṃ sotāpanna-satato etassa sakadāgāmissa dānaṃ.pa. Paccekabuddhasatato bhagavato. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 87.
sotāpannasutta:
[ sotāpanna + sutta]  CL=7  Saṃyutta Nikāya 22.109 (SN22.109), 23.7 (SN23.7), 48.26 (SN48.26), 48.32 (SN48.32).
Saṃyuttanikāya, khandhavaggasaṃyuttapāḷi, khandhasaṃyuta, 1-vaga, 7-suta. Saṃ, 2. 131.
sotāpannaupāsaka:
[ sotāpanna + upāsaka ]  CL=7 A lay devotee who has entered the stream.
Ekaṃ mahākālaṃ nāma sotāpannaupāsakaṃ ārabbha kathesi. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 95.
sotāpannavisaya: [ sotāpanna + visaya ]  CL=7 The subject matter that can only be understood by a sotāpanna. Puthujjano attano visaye peuha vissajjetvā sotāpannavisaye pauhaṃ vissajjetuṃ nāsikkhiṃsu. Dhamma, ṭṭha, 2. 147.
sotāpannañāṇa:
[ sotāpanna + ñāṇa]  CL=7 The wisdom of a stream-enterer or a person"s knowledge has entered the path of stream-entry.
Tattha ---- sotāpannañāṇassa dasabyāmaudakaṃ opammabhāvena dassetvā. Dī, ṭī, 3. 57.
sotāpannādigottābhibhavana:
[ sotāpanna + ādi + gotta + abhibhavana ]  CL=7 Overcoming the state of a sotāpanna and similar beings.
tīsu maggavāresu sotā-pannādigottābhibhavanato gotrabhūti attho veditabbo. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 253.
sotāpannādiniyatabheda:
[ sotā-pannādi + niyata + bheda ]  CL=7 The various kinds of fixed destinies, including those of a sotāpanna and similar beings.
Niyatā-niyatabheda (mūlaṭī, 2. 208) nti sotāpannādiniyatabhedaṃ, sattakkhattu-paramādianiyatabhedañca. Anuṭī, 2. 210.
sotāpannādisekha:
[ sotāpannādi + sekha ]  CL=7 A noble person (sekkha) such as a sotāpanna and similar beings.
Yadā pana sotāpannādisekho vuttanayena neyyaṃ parijānāti. Netti, ṭṭha. 77.
sotāpannādisekkhasantāna:
[ sotā-pannādi + sekkha + santāna ]  CL=7 The continuity of a noble person (sekkha) such as a sotāpanna and similar beings.
Sotāpannādisekkhasantāne bhāvanāya pahātabbassa kiriyabhāvo āpajjati. Anuṭī, 2. 105.
sotāpannādisāvaka:
[ sotāpannādi + sāvaka ]  CL=7 Disciples or followers of persons such as a sotāpanna and similar beings.
Itaro sotāpannādīnaṃ sotāpannādisāvaka-bhāvato paṭikkhipati. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 182.
sotāpatti:
[ sota + āpatti. sotasadisattā vā “soto”ti vuccati ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, tassa āpatti ādito pajjanaṃ pāpuṇanaṃ paṭhamasamannāgamo sotāpatti. atha vā ariyamaggasotassa ādito pajjanaṃ etassāti sotāpatti. puggalo. vibhāvinī. 97. pajjanaṃ patti, ādito patti āpatti, sotassa āpatti sotā-pattīti atthaṃ dasseti. ādito patti āpatti, sotassa āpatti etassā-ti sotāpattīti bhinnādhikaraṇa-bāhiratthasamāsaṃ dasseti. maṇimañjū, 1. 273-4. ေ္ra$ာtāpatti-sakkatapiṭaka. ]  CL=7 (1) First attained the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga). (2) The path of stream-entry (sotāpattimagga). (3) The sotāpanna person who has first entered the path leading to arahantship. (4) Quickly attain the path that leads to arahantship. See - sotāpattimagga, sotapattiyaṅga and sotāpattimaggacitta. (2) The path of stream-entry (sotāpattimagga). See - sotāpattiyaṅga. (3) The sotāpanna person who has first entered the path leading to arahantship. See - sotāpattimagga. (4) Quickly attain the path that leads to arahantship. See - sotāpattiyaṅga. (5) Sotāpattisaṃyutta, saṃyutta Nikāya 55 (SN55).
Sotāpattisaccāti, mahāvaggoti vuccati. Saṃ, 3. 415.
sotāpattiattha:
[ sotāpatti + attha]  CL=7 The benefit of a stream-entry path (sotāpattimagga).
Sotāpattiatthaṃ aṅganti attho. Saṃ, ṭī, 2. 85.
sotāpattiaṅga: [ sotāpatti + aṅga]  CL=7 The factors (or elements) of attaining the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga). Sotāpattiyaṅgesū (paṭisaṃ. 210) ti ettha soto ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, sotassa āpatti bhusaṃ pāpuṇanaṃ sotāpatti, sotāpattiyā aṅgāni sambhārāni sotāpattiaṅgāni. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 137.
sotāpattimagga:
[ sotāpatti + magga ]  CL=7 (1) First attained the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga) and the noble path (ariyāmagga). (2) The path of the Sotāpana person who first attained the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga) and the noble path (ariyāmagga). (3) The path that is the cause of reaching the stream-entry (sotāpattimagga) and the noble path (ariyāmagga).
 (1) (2) Sotāpattimaggo abhiññeyyo. Paṭisaṃ. 21. Sotassa āpajjanaṃ sotāpatti, sotāpatti eva maggo sotāpattimaggo. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 99. Sotāpattimaggo sakadāgāmimaggo anāgāmimaggo ----. Visuddhi, 2. 312. Sotassa ariyassa ādito pajjanaṃ sotāpatti, so eva maggo sotaṃ vā ariyaṃ ādito pajjati adhigacchatīti sotāpatti, paṭhamako. Tassa maggo sotāpattimaggo. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 483. (3) Sotāpattimaggaṃ bhāventopi. Mahāni. 6. Maggasotassa āpajjanaṃ sotāpatti, sotāpattiyā maggo sotāpattimaggo. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 31.
sotāpattimaggabojjhaṅga:
[ sotāpattimagga + bojjhaṅga ]  CL=7 The element of awakening associated with the path of stream entry.
Sotāpattimaggabojjhaṅgānaṃ bujjha-naṭṭho. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 94.
sotāpattimaggacakkhu:
[ sotāpattimagga + cakkhu ]  CL=7 The eye of the stream entry (sotāpattimagga) that is the wisdom associated with the path of stream entry (sotāpattimaggañāṇa).
Myakaci, sotāpattimagañāṇa. Dhammacakkhu (aṃ, 1. 244) nti catusaccadhammapariggāhakaṃ sotāpattimaggacakkhuṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 222.
sotāpattimaggacitta:
[ sotāpattimagga + citta ]  CL=7 (1) The consciousness associated with the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga) that first leads to the noble path (ariyāmagga). (2) The consciousness of the one who has first attained stream entry (sotāpattimagga).
(1) (2) Tassa āpatti ādito pajjanaṃ pāpuṇanaṃ paṭhamasamannāgamo sotāpatti kilese mārento gacchatīti vā maggo. Tena sampayuttaṃ cittaṃ maggacittaṃ, sotā-pattiyā laddhaṃ maggacittaṃ sotāpatti-maggacittaṃ. Atha vā ariyamaggasotassa ādito pajjanaṃ etassāti sotā-patti, puggalo, tassa maggo sotā-pattimaggo, tena sampayuttaṃ cittaṃ sotāpattimaggacittaṃ. Vibhāvinī. 97.
sotāpattimaggadiṭṭhi:
[ sotāpattimagga + diṭṭhi ]  CL=7 The wisdom associated with the path of sotāpatti (stream entry).
Yāyaṃ sotāpattimagga-diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti ----. Ma, ṭṭha, 2. 298. Ma, ṭī, 2. 308.
sotāpattimaggahetu:
[ sotāpattimagga + hetu ]  CL=7 A cause of the attainment of the path of stream-entry.
Atha satthā paccusasamaye lokaṃ volokento tassa sotāpattimaggahetuṃ disvā ----. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 305.
sotāpattimaggakkhaṇa:
[ sotāpattimagga + khaṇa ]  CL=7 A moment of the stream entry (sotāpattimagga).
Sotāpattimaggakkhaṇe dhammānusārī nāma. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 44.
sotāpattimaggakāraṇa:
[ sotā-pattimagga + kāraṇa ]  CL=7 A cause of entering the stream entry (sotāpattimagga) and the noble path (ariyāmagga).
Sappurisasaṃsevo saddhammassavanaṃ yonisomanasikāro dhammānudhammappaṭipattīti imesu catūsu sotāpattimaggakāraṇesu. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 5.
sotāpattimagganiyāma:
[ sotāpattimagga + niyāma ]  CL=7 Certainty of the path of stream-entry.
Sotāpattimagganiyāmena niya-to (aṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 217) ti uparimaggādhigamassa avassaṃbhāvībhāvato niyato.
sotāpattimaggapaññā:
[ sotāpattimagga + paññā ]  CL=7 The wisdom associated with the path of stream-entry.
Sotāpattimaggapaññā-yetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 198.
sotāpattimaggapaṭilābhattha:
[ sotā-pattimaggapaṭilābha + attha ]  CL=7 The benefit of well-attainment of the path of sotāpatti (stream entry).
Sotā-pattimaggapaṭilābhatthāyā (visuddhi, 2. 341) ti sotāpattimaggassa samadhigamāya. Visuddhi, ṭī, 2. 516.
sotāpattimaggappaṭilābha:
[ sotāpatti-magga + paṭilābha ]  CL=7 The attainment of the path of stream-entry.
Yaṃ sotāpattimaggappaṭilābhato pubbabhāge sotāpattippaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. Aṃ, ṭī, 3. 294. (-apa, ṭṭha, 1. 265).
sotāpattimaggarati:
[ sotāpattimagga + rati ]  CL=7 Delight in the path of stream-entry. 
sotāpattimaggaratiṃ sotāpattiphalaratiṃ, sakadāgāmi-anāgāmiarahattamaggaphalaratiñca janeti. Suttani, ṭṭha, 1. 278.
sotāpattimaggasahajāta:
[ sotā-pattimagga + sahajāta ]  CL=7 Arising together with the path of stream-entry.
Sotāpattimaggasahajā-tā sukhumā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 16. (-mūlaṭī, 3. 155).
sotāpattimaggasamadhigama:
[ sotāpatti-magga + saṃ + adhigama ]  CL=7 Well-achieved in the path of stream entry.
Te devā tassa sotāpattimaggasamadhigamaṃ āsīsantā evaṃ vadanti. Itivuta, ṭṭha. 246.
sotāpattimaggasamaṅgī:
[ sotāpattimagga + samaṅgī ]  CL=7 One who is endowed with the path of stream-entry.
Avasāne pana dve sotāpattimagga-samaṅgino. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 133. (-abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 39).
sotāpattimaggasammādiṭṭhi:
[ sotā-pattimagga + sammādiṭṭhi ]  CL=7 Sammādiṭṭhi associated with the path of stream-entry.
Heṭṭhā kosambiya-sutte pana sotāpattimaggasammādiṭṭhi kathitā. Ma, ṭṭha, 4. 34. Ma, ṭī, 3. 246.
sotāpattimaggasammādiṭṭhisaññita:
[ sotāpattimaggasammādiṭṭhi + saññita ]  CL=7 That which should be recognized by the right view (sammādiṭṭhi) associated with the path of stream-entry.
Lokuttarasīla-sampayutteneva sotāpattimaggasammā-diṭṭhisaññitena dassanena sampanno ----. Khuddaka, ṭṭha. 214.
sotāpattimaggasampayutta:
[ sotā-pattimagga + sampayutta ]  CL=7 Associated with the path of stream entry.
Lokuttaro ca sotā-pattimaggasampayuttā oḷārikā. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 232. Sārattha, 3. 189.
sotāpattimaggasampayuttapaññā: [ sotā-pattimaggasampayutta + paññā ]  CL=7 The wisdom associated with the path of stream-entry. See - sotāpattimaggañāṇa.
sotāpattimaggavajjha:
[ sotāpattimagga + vajjha ]  CL=7 Rejected or obstructed the path of stream-entry.
Ayāthāvamānā sotā-pattimaggavajjhā. Abhi, ṭṭha, 2. 469. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 2. 32. Mahāni, ṭṭha. 183.
sotāpattimaggavīriya:
[ sotāpattimagga + vīriya ]  CL=7 The effort associated with the path of stream entry.
Puthujjano pana sotāpattimagga-vīriyaṃ asampatto. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 247.
sotāpattimaggañāṇa:
[ sotāpattimagga + ñāṇa ]  CL=7 The wisdom associated with the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga).
Sotāpattimaggañāṇena abhi-saṅkhāraviññāṇassa nirodhenā (cūḷani. 33) ti sotāpattimaggasampayutta-paññāya ----. Cūḷani, ṭṭha. 3.
sotāpattimaggaṭṭha:
[ sotāpattimagga + ṭhā + a ]  CL=7 One who is established in stream-entry (sotāpattimagga).
Sotāpattimaggaṭṭho aññampi sotāpattimaggaṭṭhaṃ karonto sammā viharati nāma. Dī, ṭṭha, 2. 181.
sotāpattimaggaṭṭhapuggala:
[ sotāpatti-maggaṭṭha + puggala ]  CL=7 A person established in the path of sotāpatti (stream-entry).
aṭṭhamakassa sotā-pattimaggaṭṭhapuggalassa dve pariyuṭṭhānā pahīnāti ----. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 172.
sotāpattimaggindriya:
[ sotāpattimagga + indriya ]  CL=7 The mental faculty involved in the path of stream-entry.
Tato mudutarāni sotāpattimaggindriyāni nāma honti. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 3. 266.
sotāpattimaggobhāsa:
[ sotāpatti-magga + obhāsa ]  CL=7 The brightness of the path of stream-entry.
Dīpobhāso viya sotāpattimaggobhāso. Abhi, ṭṭha, 1. 285.
sotāpattimaggābhibhavana:
[ sotāpatti-magga + abhibhavana ]  CL=7 Overcome by the path of stream-entry.
Sotāpattimaggābhibhavanasakadāgāmi-maggābhibhavana ----. Netti, vi. 248.
sotāpattimaggādhigama:
[ sotāpattimagga + adhigama ]  CL=7 The attainment of the path of stream-entry.
anekadevatānaṃ sotāpattimaggā-dhigamanaṃ katvā. Apa, ṭṭha, 1. 132.
sotāpattiniyāma: [ sotāpatti + niyāma ]  CL=7 The fixed order or certainty of the path of stream entry (sotāpattimagga). Sotāpattiniyāmo asaṅkhatoti, āmantā. Abhi, ka. 239. Tattha niyāmoti ---- ariya-maggo vuccati. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 191.
sotāpattiphala:
[ sotāpatti + phala]  CL=7 (1) The fruit of stream-entry (sotāpattiphala) attained through the path of stream-entry (sotāpattimagga). (2) The fruit of stream entry (sotāpattiphala) that is experienced by the sotāpanna.
(1) Sotāpattiphala-sacchikiriyā (aṃ, 1. 22) ti sototi paṭhamamaggo, tena sotena pattabbaṃ phalanti sotāpattiphalaṃ. Aṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 93. (2) Parihāyati sotāpanno sotā-pattiphalāti, na hevaṃ vattabbe. Abhi, ka. 61-3. Sotāpattiphalassa anantarā arahattaṃyeva sacchikarotīti vuttaṃ. Abhi, ṭṭha, 3. 143. Sotāpattiyā phalaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ. Paṭisaṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 99.
sotāpattiphalakkhaṇa: [ sotāpatti-phala + khaṇa ]  CL=7 The moment of experiencing the fruit of stream entry (sotāpattiphala). Sotāpattiphalakkhaṇe dassanaṭṭhena sammādiṭṭhi tadā samugatā. Paṭisaṃ. 72.
sotāpattiphalapaṭilābha:
